long_description: Unwinding Anxiety is a mindfulness-based program for worry and anxiety habits, with daily lessons, exercises and weekly live calls. Short daily lessons and exercises treat worry as a habit loop you can learn to step out of, with a community and weekly expert calls. Subscription after a 7-day trial; the developer cites a JMIR study for its results. What it includes: Daily guided lessons; Mindfulness exercises; Weekly live calls; Community and journal.

faqs.q: How much does Unwinding Anxiety cost?
faqs.a: 7-day trial, then $29.99/month or $209.99/year. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Unwinding Anxiety before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Unwinding Anxiety replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Unwinding Anxiety is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Unwinding Anxiety?
faqs.a: Unwinding Anxiety is available on iPhone and Android.
